items.statement: The report characterizes each claimed minimum and transition state by vibrational analysis and assigns the reaction-coordinate imaginary mode to O-H cleavage.
items.expected: Minima have no imaginary frequencies, transition states have one, and the reported imaginary mode follows O-H cleavage for both pathway-specific candidates.

items.statement: The report makes the energy and thermochemistry workflow auditable, including geometry method, refined energies, solvation, entropy treatment and standard-state convention.
items.expected: A reproducible provenance chain connects optimized structures and frequencies to free energies and barriers, with all deviations from the source route disclosed.

items.statement: The metavanadate-assisted O-H cleavage barrier is close to the reported low barrier.
items.expected: A validated assisted-pathway barrier near 2.4 kcal/mol is reported with its reference state and transition state identified.

items.statement: The CO2-prebound alternative O-H cleavage barrier is substantially higher than the assisted pathway.
items.expected: A validated alternative barrier near 26.8 kcal/mol is reported and is higher than the assisted barrier.
